chunks: Said the brothers: 'If he has stolen (no wonder), his brother had stolen before.' But Joseph kept this secret and did not disclose it to them, and said (to himself): 'You are worse in the degree of evil, for God knows better of what you allege.'
ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Joseph conceal the truth about his brothers' earlier theft?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (AS) conceals his awareness of his brothers' prior theft of his garment, using their own accusation as a subtle psychological lever. Shia scholars highlight the phrase 'You are worse in position' (antum sharun makana) as indicating that their current act of accusing an innocent brother was more grievous than their initial crime, reflecting a deeper moral decline. This moment underscores Joseph's divine composure and strategic patience before revealing his identity.
